name: Voxel LOD System
definition: A system for rendering voxel worlds up to 2^31-1 x 2^31-1 x 2^31-1 voxels using dynamic Level Of Details (LOD) and on-the-fly generation, where world generators are queried only when needed and low-resolution chunks require less data querying.
summary: The Voxel LOD System dynamically adjusts voxel chunk resolution based on viewer proximity and eliminates visual seams between differing resolutions using transition meshes.
